responsibility: Specializes the x86 Cygwin target configuration for 32/64-bit multilib builds that use the 64-bit-capable runtime conventions. It overrides assembler and linker specs to select 32-bit versus 64-bit PE emulations, chooses the appropriate DLL entry point and default multilib, adjusts long/size/pointer-difference type sizes for the 64-bit Cygwin ABI, and sets the libgcc shared-library soname, making it the Cygwin-w64 multilib policy header on top of the common cygming setup.
